title: Build lines is not offered until the inspection is ready for it
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. Seed three states: (a) an inspection that is not completed; (b) a completed inspection with only OK/N/A findings (no Monitor or Not OK); (c) a shop configured with no labor types.
custom_steps:
1. On the not-completed inspection, confirm the build is not offered.
2. On the completed inspection with only OK/N/A findings, confirm the build is not offered.
3. On a shop with no labor types, confirm the build does not run and states the reason.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If the inspection is not completed, the build is not offered.
  • If the inspection has no Monitor or Not OK findings, the build is not offered.
  • If the shop has no labor types, the build does not run and states the reason, because a line cannot be created without a labor type or a fixed price.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9100 (S2 — Turn findings into work order lines); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S2; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-N1: “If the inspection is not completed, the build will not be offered”
  • S2-N2: “If the inspection has no Monitor or Not OK findings, the build will not be offered”
  • S2-N6: “If the shop has no labor types, the build will not run. A work order line cannot be created without a labor type or a fixed price, and S2-R18 forbids a generated line from being a Fixed Line Total, so the action states the reason rather than producing a line that cannot be saved”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
